facts.statement: Purranisaurus reached a length of about 3.3 meters.
The genus Purranisaurus was originally described by Rusconi in 1948.
Gasparini later demonstrated that Purranisaurus is a metriorhynchid crocodyliform.
facts.quote: Gasparini demonstrated that it was in fact a metriorhynchid crocodyliform

facts.statement: Phylogenetic analyses in the 2000s confirmed Purranisaurus as a distinct metriorhynchid genus.
facts.quote: In the 2000s phylogenetic analysis has shown that Purranisaurus is a distinct metriorhynchid genus.

facts.statement: Purranisaurus belongs to the subfamily Geosaurinae.
Purranisaurus lived in marine environments in Chile and Argentina during the Middle to Late Jurassic periods.
facts.quote: grupo de crocodilomorfos marinos procedentes del periodo Jurásico Medio a Tardío de Chile y Argentina

facts.statement: The type species P. potens lived during the Late Jurassic (Tithonian) in Argentina.
facts.quote: P. potens: Jurásico Superior de Argentina (Tithoniano)

facts.statement: The species P. casamiquelai lived during the Middle Jurassic (Callovian) in Chile.
facts.quote: P. casamiquelai: Jurásico Medio de Chile (Calloviano)

facts.statement: The species P. westermanni lived during the Middle Jurassic (Callovian) in Chile.
facts.quote: P. westermanni: Jurásico Medio de Chile (Calloviano)

facts.statement: The time range for Purranisaurus is estimated from 145.06 to 141 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Tithonian to Berriasian (145.06 to 141 million years ago)

facts.statement: It is debated whether Purranisaurus potens is a junior synonym of Metriorhynchus.
facts.quote: that may be a junior synonym of Metriorhynchus

facts.statement: A subsequent study expanded the genus Purranisaurus to include the species Metriorhynchus casamiquelai and M. westermanni.
facts.quote: Un estudio subsecuente expandió el género Purranisaurus al incluir las especies Metriorhynchus casamiquelai y a M. westermanni.

rejected.statement: Purranisaurus is an extinct genus of marine crocodyliform found in the Late Jurassic Vaca Muerta formation of Argentina.
rejected.quote: Purranisaurus is an extinct genus of marine crocodyliform from the Late Jurassic aged Vaca Muerta of Argentina.
